svg.aria-label: QSL compiles source through a lossless syntax tree and parsed forms into a checked graph, resolving names against domain models and dependency packages, then links a checked package. The package goes three ways: to the reference evaluator, to native model checking, or as checked-package/v2 bytes to Contract IR and proof backends. A counterexample from any engine is replayed through the same compiler and evaluator to confirm it.
